Our story

A long table since 1997

We opened in 1997 with our family recipes: dips, kibbe, the charcoal grill and warm bread. Almost thirty years later the idea is the same: plates in the middle and room for the whole family.

Nobody orders just for themselves here. We order for the table.

FAQ

Before you order

Where are you located?

We have two branches in Anzoátegui state, Venezuela: Lechería (0424-806 0218) and Puerto La Cruz (0412-750 5025). In the “Visit us” section you will find the “Get directions” link for each one.

What are the opening hours?

We open every day at 11:30 a.m. Monday to Thursday we close at 10:00 p.m., Friday and Saturday at 11:00 p.m. and Sunday at 9:00 p.m.

Do you deliver?

Yes. We deliver to Lechería, Nueva Barcelona, Barcelona, Puerto La Cruz and Guanta, and you can also pick up your order at either of our two branches. Build your order on our ordering page and confirm it on WhatsApp; the delivery fee is confirmed according to the area.

Do you have vegetarian options?

Yes. Our Arabic starters include hummus, mutabal, falafel, tabbouleh and fattoush, and the menu has several salads. If you have a dietary restriction, ask us about the ingredients of each dish.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept Pago móvil, cash in bolívares or US dollars, Binance and Zinli.

How long has El Amir Palace been open?

Since 1997. We have been cooking Lebanese and Mediterranean recipes in Anzoátegui for almost three decades, today with branches in Lechería and Puerto La Cruz.

Which dishes do you recommend for sharing?

The Arabic platter, for 2, 3 or 4 people, the El Amir skewers and the mixed grill. To start, hummus, kibbe and vine leaves in the middle of the table.
